newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares close lower on CVRD delay.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares close lower on CVRD delay.

text.p: Brazil shares ended lower Monday on continuing concerns about the privatization auction of state miner Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), which has been delayed due to legal challenges, brokers said.
The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 48 most active stocks lost 0.8 percent to close at 9,994 points. Market turnover slowed to 431.4 million reais ($406.9 million).
Analysts are still confident CVRD will be privatized, but some said they are losing hopes that the firm will be auctioned off this week.
"We did not expect that the government would face such resistance in the judiciary to the sale," said a senior trader.
The CVRD sale depends on a high court judge reviewing a government appeal against all injunctions blocking the sale. He is expected to make a decision later Monday or Tuesday.

So far, the government has managed to have 19 of 23 injunctions overturned. Among the remaining four, one granted by a Sao Paulo court at the request of some of the country's leading lawyers, has been the most difficult to reverse.
Uncertainties about the government's civil service reform, seen as key to Brazil's attempts to cut public spending, also took their toll on the Brazilian bolsa.
Congressional officials expect to finish voting on amendments to the administrative reform this week, but traders are skeptical the voting will take place.

Analysts said the market is likely to remain bearish early Tuesday unless the high court judge decides for the government. Vale preferred shares closed off 1.3 percent at 26.65 reais, while the firm's voting stock lost 2.03 percent to 28.90 reais.
Bellwether Telebras ended off 1.21 percent at 114.30 reais. percent lower at 228 reais.
Power utility Eletrobras fell 0.6 percent to 496 reais.
The Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index lost 0.29 percent to end at 2,731 points.
